dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: As you can see, it's just a "storybook" that's been knocked over.

dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: A never-ending tea party, a clock that runs backward, talking penguins, and a princess of flowers... In short, nothing but useless fairy{RUBY#[D]fantasies}-tale.

dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: After all, fairy tales are written for children who refuse to go to sleep. And the children here, my dear friend, have been awake for far too long.
